columns.name: PrincipalId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the user target set by a principal.

columns.name: CategoryId
columns.description: The ID of the user target's category.

columns.name: StructuredMinutes
columns.description: The structured record duration of the user target. Field can be null.

columns.name: UnstructuredMinutes
columns.description: The unstructured record duration of the user target. Field can be null.

columns.name: StructuredRecordCount
columns.description: The structured record count of the user target. Field can be null.

columns.name: UnstructuredRecordCount
columns.description: The unstructured record count of the user target. Field can be null.

columns.name: StartDate
columns.description: Start date (UTC) of the rolling or specific period for user annual target and progress tracking. Field can be null.

columns.name: DateDeleted
columns.description: The date and time (UTC) the category was deleted. Field can be null.

columns.name: LastModified
columns.description: The date and time (UTC) the user target was added or last updated based on the Tracking Method.

columns.name: Version
columns.description: Indicates the version of the row. The Version of the user target is updated based on the Tracking Method.
